title: Fonctions L / Équation fonctionnelle des fonctions L (cas géométrique) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page does not belong to the L-function manuscript. It is a typed (stencilled) page from a Bourbaki rédaction: header '6 - 34', 'n° 392'. It contains exercises for the chapter on divisors and Krull rings, i.e. the material that became Algèbre Commutative ch. VII (§1 and §4: pseudo-null modules, pseudo-isomorphisms, the invariants χ and c). The adjacent pages are Grothendieck's handwritten notes on functional equations of L-functions. The sheet was most likely reused as scrap paper, or simply filed with them. Its numbering 65 is the archive's.

Exercise 6. A = k[X²,XY,Y²] ⊂ B = k[X,Y] is the ring of invariants of ±1, i.e. the A1 quadric cone.
- A is normal and noetherian, and B is finite over A.
- p = (X², XY) is the height-1 prime of the ruling line X=0, since A/p ≅ k[Y²]. It is therefore divisorial.
- p⊗_A B has torsion. The element Y(X²⊗1) − X(XY⊗1) maps to 0 in pB and is killed by X, because XY·X² − X²·XY = 0 is a relation over A.
- pB = X·(X,Y) is not divisorial; its divisorial hull is XB.
- So p⊗B → pB is not injective, and p is not flat.

Exercise 7. For E torsion-free of finite type over a normal noetherian ring, E*⊗E → End(E) is a pseudo-isomorphism. At height-1 primes A_p is a DVR and E_p is free, so the map localizes to an isomorphism. Consequently E is projective iff E*⊗E is reflexive. If E*⊗E is reflexive, the map to the reflexive module End(E) is bijective, and then a standard trace argument gives projectivity.

Exercise 8 (starred).
- Tor_i and Ext^i (i≥2) are pseudo-null, by reduction to DVRs (principal case).
- Tor_1 and Ext^1 are pseudo-null when M1 is torsion-free.
- For M1 torsion: additivity formulas for χ (the divisor of lengths at height-1 primes) of ⊗, Hom, Tor_1, Ext^1, involving the rank r.
- For general M1, M2: the analogous 'first Chern class' formulas for c (the class in Cl(A)): c(M1⊗M2) − c(Tor_1) = r1c2 + r2c1 and c(Hom) − c(Ext^1) = r1c2 − r2c1.
errors: No mathematical errors detected. Sanity checks over a DVR work out: M1=k, M2=A gives 0−1=−1; Hom(A,k)=k gives +1; M1=A, M2=invertible I gives c(I)=c(I).
The cross-reference 'avec les notations du n°  )' has a blank number in the original typescript.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typed Bourbaki draft page (rédaction n° 392) of AC VII exercises filed among the L-function notes, probably reused as scratch paper. Its content corresponds to published Bourbaki material. The only point of interest is archival: it documents a Bourbaki draft of AC VII among Grothendieck's papers.
transcription_corrections: The page is a typed stencil, not handwritten; header '6 - 34 -' and 'n° 392' (Bourbaki rédaction number) are correctly read.
In 8a the typescript reads 'Ext^i_A(M_1,M_2)' with superscript i; transcription is correct.
A '*' precedes exercise 8 and closes after 8d, marking a starred (harder) exercise. It is not a footnote.
